content:
Apple has pushed out the third developer beta of iOS 27.2 for iPhone. Coming on the heels of iOS 27's official rollout to all users and skipping iOS 27.1, which Apple has positioned as an iPhone Duo-focused update.

iOS 27.2 beta brings a new Health app and more

iOS 27.2 will be the version following iOS 27's official launch on September 14. iOS 27.1 is for iPhone Duo only.

Apple has detailed how the iOS 27.1 SDK will let developers take full advantage of the iPhone Duo's display. You can learn more about how apps will appear on iPhone Duo depending on the iOS version they're built for here.

Apple released Xcode 27.1 beta on September 18, adding an iPhone Duo simulator and app development support for the new foldable iPhone.

Apple also rolled out the first public beta of iOS 27.2 last month.

The iOS 27.2 beta includes the following changes:

  • The redesigned Health app, first announced by Apple at the iPhone 18 Pro event, makes its debut in this beta.
  • Group FaceTime gains a dual-camera simultaneous shooting mode.
  • Siri AI language support expands to include French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Apple TV app profile feature lands on iPhone.
  • Apple Podcasts' "Up Next" has been renamed "Latest Episodes," with the "Continue Playing" section moved beneath "Latest Episodes." Podcast episode list backgrounds will also match the show's theme colors.
  • Icon color saturation for labels inside the Apple Music app has been reduced.

We'll break down what's new and changed in the third beta in a separate roundup post if we spot anything new. Keep following our iOS 27.2 beta ongoing coverage.
